extDescription.message: Send Chrome downloads to the FLEX Download Manager desktop app.

popupOffline.message: FLEX Download Manager is not running

popupHintOnline.message: Chrome downloads open in the Download File Info dialog.

popupHintOffline.message: Start the desktop app, then click Check again.

savePromptTip.message: Chrome can show its own Save As dialog. Turn off “Ask where to save each file before downloading” so only the FLEX Download Manager dialog appears.

settingsOpenFailed.message: Open chrome://settings/downloads manually and turn off the Save As prompt.

autoCaptureHint.message: When off, downloads stay in Chrome.

appOffTitle.message: FLEX Download Manager is not running

appOffMessage.message: Start the desktop app to use the download dialog.

mediaPanelHint.message: Shows a Download this video button over videos and audio.

panelSent.message: Download added to the desktop app.

panelOffline.message: FLEX Download Manager is not running.

panelRejected.message: The desktop app refused this download. Check its settings and try again.

panelBridgeUnavailable.message: The browser extension could not reach the desktop app. Reload the extension in chrome://extensions, reload this page, then try again.

panelNoSource.message: No direct media link was detected yet. Start the video, then click the panel again.

panelExtractFailed.message: Could not read this video's qualities. Make sure yt-dlp.exe is next to the desktop app.

panelHelpText.message: Click the panel to choose a quality. YouTube and other social sites are handled by yt-dlp, so every resolution is listed; the first 1080p+ download also installs ffmpeg.
